title: worker.team: one signed action fields a temporary worker team (Foundry #48) under one grant
problem: Foundry #48 teams existed, but no signed GREG action fielded a worker organization, and no mission ran two WorkOrders at once (S23.A3, S38.A2, S39.A1 blocked on WU-03). The founder asked for two genuinely concurrent workers under one grant through #48 on foundry.apply, with distinct roles and orders, a parent spend cap, independent appraisal, dissolution that stops further action, and refusal of paid roles whose spend cannot be metered.
founder_intent_refs: Founder decision in this session, 2026-11-21, recorded on #96 comment 7068061767, item 2 (WU-03)
acceptance/directive-sections.json WU-03; asks S23.A3, S38.A2, S39.A1
ARCHITECTURE-OWNERSHIP-MAP OWN-FN-TEMPORARY-TEAMS migration_path: a GREG team runner forms its teams through #48 on foundry.apply
baseline: #196 12119590: no worker.team; one worker.commission per action; #48 reachable only as raw foundry ops

alternatives.name: Two worker.commission strategies in one mission
alternatives.description: Sign each worker as its own action and let Background run them at once.
disadvantages: Background holds one dispatch per mission, so they run one after the other
Two grants and two caps, not one team under one grant
alternatives.revival_evidence: Background dispatch keyed by action instead of mission

alternatives.name: worker.team adapter over #48 through foundry.apply (selected)
alternatives.description: Compile the swarm contract (#1), attach a competence per provider (#12), form/act/dissolve/report through #48, run member WorkOrders on threads.
advantages: #48 stays the one canonical team implementation
Members are ordinary WorkOrders: no new worker authority
disadvantages: Several Foundry subprocess calls per team
The team's stores are action-private, not mission-canonical

alternatives.name: A new GREG team runtime
disadvantages: A second implementation of a canonically owned function; the owner guard refuses it

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: No mission fields a team; S38.A2 stays sequential; WU-04 has nothing to gate.

roles.position: Every named condition is a test: concurrency, distinct roles and orders, parent cap, independent appraisal, dissolution, unmetered refusal.
material_concerns: The team is one signed action and one grant; members cannot exceed it

roles.position: #48 stays canonical; greg/teams.py is a caller recorded in the ownership map.
material_concerns: Team stores are action-private (journal=None) so the mission's canonical Foundry store is untouched

roles.position: Attacked: a stop after members ran turned the action REFUSED and booked nothing for real spend. Fixed: bookkeeping after start ignores the stop, and the outcome is UNCERTAIN with the cap reserved.
material_concerns: A member that raises is charged at its whole cap
An instance attribute cannot claim metering; only the provider class can

roles.position: worker.team runs off the turn (BACKGROUND_CAPABILITIES) and behind the egress relay (CONFINED_EGRESS), like worker.commission.
material_concerns: codex and aider are refused as team members until they report spend

roles.position: Each member's work order is appraised alone against the one team receipt.
material_concerns: worker.appraise reads the member's entry in the team receipt; any field mismatch rejects

evidence.claim: Both members enter their work before either is released
evidence.finding: Two threads reach one Barrier(2) while the release event is unset; both pass together

evidence.claim: Combined spend within the parent cap
evidence.finding: Caps 0.4 + 0.4 reserved under a 1.0 signed cap; booked 0.40 measured; #48 records the same 0.40

evidence.claim: Caps above the signed cap never start
evidence.finding: 0.6 + 0.6 under 1.0 is refused; no member called
After the team dissolves, a #48 act through foundry.apply raises 'DISSOLVED'
On 12119590 worker.team does not exist; every test fails

counterevidence.claim: A cancelled team is not stopped instantly
counterevidence.finding: Test-double members are not governed providers, so they finish before they see the stop; the outcome is UNCERTAIN with the cap reserved

pass_1.intended_outcome: A founder-signed mission fields a bounded team of concurrent workers whose combined spend and authority never exceed the one grant.

advantages.amplified_value: S38.A2's parallelism lands where it materially shortens wall time
One weak member cannot ride on another's acceptance

disadvantages.statement: Team stores are action-private, not mission-canonical
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Created fresh per grant; the receipt carries the #48 journal and spend

disadvantages.statement: Unmetered CLI providers cannot join a team
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Refused before formation; a provider joins once it reports spend

disadvantages.statement: A stopped team still finishes its members' bookkeeping
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Outcome is UNCERTAIN; the signed cap stays reserved until reconciled

pass_1.selected_design: greg/teams.py field: #1 compile, #12 attach, #48 form, parallel worker.commission, #48 act per member, #48 dissolve, #48 report

comparisons.reversible_experiment: Unsigned missions never field a team; revert removes the builtin

rejected_alternatives.name: Two worker.commission strategies
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Background runs one dispatch per mission

pass_2.attack_summary: Re-attacked for lost spend, borrowed authority, cross-member appraisal and post-dissolution action.

new_weaknesses.statement: A stop after members ran made the action REFUSED, booking 0 for real spend
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Post-start bookkeeping ignores the stop; outcome UNCERTAIN; cap reserved

new_weaknesses.statement: A member that raises could have spent

new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Bounded at 2 + 2 per provider + 2 per member calls; each 30 s wall-capped

residual_risks.risk: A real governed worker sees the stop only between its own checks
residual_risks.mitigation: Its spend is bounded by its reserved cap
residual_risks.review_trigger: A team with a real Claude Code member

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: The mission's canonical Foundry store is untouched
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: A mission that consumes a team's store
A CLI provider that reports spend

pass_2.final_design: worker.team builtin (greg/teams.py) over #48 through foundry.apply; members are worker.commission WorkOrders on threads under the action's grant; spend metered as team.spent_usd; worker.appraise binds each member to the team receipt.

migration_plan: None: a new builtin; worker.appraise accepts the team receipt shape in addition to the commission receipt.

steps: Revert the commit; no mission signs worker.team without it

kill_criteria: A team's booked spend below its members' measured spend
Any act accepted after the team dissolved
decision_owner: the #196 integrator, on this draft's evidence; merge remains the founder's
review_trigger: The first team with a real metered member, or WU-04's organization-vs-simpler gate
